events.verdict: Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) initiates contact across Allen's (CLE) left arm prior to making contact with the ball. The illegal contact affects his ability to control the rebound.
Mobley (CLE) makes clean contact with the ball and any ensuing contact with Hartenstein (OKC) is incidental.
Wallace (OKC) maintains a legal guarding position during Mitchell's (CLE) drive to the basket.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) and Hartenstein (OKC) each momentarily engage with Allen (CLE) during the rebound.
Dort (OKC) cleanly dislodges the ball away from Allen (CLE) along the baseline.
Dort (OKC) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds.
Hartenstein (OKC) legally contests Mobley's (CLE) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Allen (CLE) and Williams (OKC) each make clean contact with the ball as they pursue the rebound.

Replay review of the foul called on Mitchell (CLE) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Mitchell releases his hand away from Dort's (OKC) back and the contact that occurs during the rebound is marginal. Mitchell had imminent possession at the time of the whistle and Cleveland was subsequently awarded possession after the review.
Hartenstein (OKC) moves forwards and meets Mobley (CLE) at the same spot, absorbing the incidental contact that occurs.
Hartenstein (OKC) absorbs the initial contact with Mobley (CLE) before further marginal contact occurs with Mobley's back during the shot attempt.
Allen (CLE) rests a hand on Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) back and the contact during his driving shot attempt is marginal.
Mobley (CLE) makes clean contact with the ball and any ensuing contact with Hartenstein (OKC) is incidental.
Wallace (OKC) reaches in multiple times but any contact that occurs with Garland (CLE) is marginal.
Garland (CLE) moves his pivot foot heel-to-toe to create distance prior to starting his dribble.
Wallace (OKC) and Williams (OKC) legally contest Garland's (CLE) driving shot attempt.
Strus (CLE) legally contests Williams' (OKC) jump shot attempt.
Joe (OKC) and Mobley (CLE) each make clean contact with the ball as they pursue the rebound.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) makes clean contact with the ball to momentarily dislodge it from Mitchell (CLE) prior to incidental arm contact occurring.
